header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.desc: Our goal: all tools in the ecosystem production-ready by end of 2026. Below the current status per tool.

goal.title: Goal: everything live by end of 2026
goal.desc: We are working hard to have the complete ecosystem production-ready by the end of this year. All tools open source, all data in IFCX.

tools.ifcx: Universal data format for the complete building model
tools.openpdf: PDF editor and annotator with a custom Rust engine
tools.opencad: 2D + 3D CAD in Rust with native DWG/DXF (community project by Hakan Seven)
tools.monty: Lightweight IFC viewer for the construction site
tools.validator: IFC validation against IDS, NL BIM Basis ILS, RVB BIM Norm
tools.opencalc: Cost estimation and budgeting (STABU/RAW, IBIS-TRAD import)
tools.openframe: Window and door frame design in 2D and 3D, with frame schedule and IFC export
tools.heatloss: Heat loss calculation per NEN 12831 & ISSO 51
tools.geotechniek: CPTs & borings: GEF + BRO-XML viewer, Robertson SBT, map overlays
tools.speech: Speech recognition and meeting notes with local AI
tools.pointcloud: View, measure, edit and convert point clouds
tools.yapp: Communication and collaboration platform (mail, chat, invoicing)
tools.bcf: BCF 2.1 issue management for BIM projects
tools.cloud: Own cloud, account and SSO platform on Nextcloud
tools.ifcroad: Visualization and editing of IfcRoad models (roads, intersections, cycle paths) per IFC 4.3 — for civil infrastructure projects
tools.bridge: Structural analysis and parametric modelling of bridges and viaducts (IfcBridge)
tools.hydro: Hydrological calculations for water works: dikes, flood barriers, sewerage and drainage (IfcMarineFacility)
tools.installer: Central hub to install, update and launch every tool
tools.safety: Health and safety plan, BLVC plan, risk matrix and safe maintenance
tools.viewer3d: Browser 3D viewer for more than twenty formats
tools.books: Digital library of historical construction books

civil.title: Civil engineering & infrastructure
civil.desc: In 2026/2027 OpenAEC is actively broadening the ecosystem towards ground, road and water works and civil engineering. Alongside the planned tools above, we are building IFCX namespaces for IfcRoad, IfcRail, IfcBridge, IfcTunnel and IfcMarineFacility — so one open format covers both buildings and infrastructure projects.
